output.one_liner: Asana is a web-based project management and team collaboration platform for organizing, planning, and automating work.

auth.notes: Asana supports OAuth 2.0 with authorization code grant flow, Personal Access Tokens (bearer tokens), and Service Accounts (Enterprise). OAuth is recommended for multi-user applications.

evidence.snippet: OAuth is a mechanism for applications to access the Asana API without access to the user's password. Instead the application gets a token
A personal access token (PAT) allows you to access the Asana REST API upon successful authentication
Asana supports the authorization code grant flow
Personal access tokens should be used similarly to OAuth access tokens passing them in the Authorization header as Bearer tokens

access.notes: Free Asana accounts can immediately generate Personal Access Tokens for API access. Developer sandbox available for testing premium features. No payment required; rate limits differ between free and paid tiers.

evidence.snippet: You can test in any of your existing workspaces, create a free account, or request a developer sandbox
You can generate a personal access token from the Asana developer console
Free domain maximum requests per minute: 150. Paid domain maximum requests per minute: 1,500

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Per-token rate limits: 150 req/min (free), 1,500 req/min (paid). Requests exceeding limits receive 429 with Retry-After header. Limits reset every minute.

evidence.snippet: The Asana API is a RESTful interface with predictable resource-oriented URLs
This reference is generated from our OpenAPI Specification
Webhooks allow you to subscribe to notifications about events that occur on Asana resources
Asana enforces multiple kinds of rate limiting to protect stability and keep the API available
Asana offers a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server which allows AI assistants to access the Asana Work Graph

buildability.rationale: Self-serve free API access, full REST+OpenAPI documentation, multiple auth methods, webhooks, MCP support, and existing production Composio toolkit confirm immediate buildability.

overview_evidence.snippet: Integrate tools, automate actions, and customize your workflows with Asana's developer platform
The Asana API is a RESTful interface with predictable resource-oriented URLs
